questions.question: What do construction zone signs look like?

options.text: Square or rectangular with white and red.
Round or octagonal with black and yellow.
Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black.

questions.correctAnswerText: Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs have an orange background with black letters or symbols. You'll see them on the right side of the road, or on both sides if the road is divided.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Use your high beam headlights.
Use your parking lights.
Use your low beam headlights.

questions.explanation: Use low beams in fog. High beams reflect off the fog and back at you, making it harder to see.

questions.question: When must you use your low beams?

options.text: On a lighted street.
On a freeway.
In fog.

questions.explanation: Use low beams when driving in fog, snow, rain, or mist. High beams reflect off these conditions and cause glare. Some vehicles have fog lights that work with low beams.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks under 18,000 pounds are allowed.
Hill ahead.
Truck stop ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions just ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready to shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
Slow-moving vehicle.
No U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop.
Merge.
Upcoming change in direction.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: How can you prevent hydroplaning in rainy weather?

options.text: Use cruise control to maintain a constant speed.
Decrease your speed.
Move to the shoulder as soon as it starts to rain.

questions.explanation: In rainy weather, slow down to reduce hydroplaning risk. Driving too fast causes your tires to ride on water instead of the road, and you lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: When should you use your horn?

options.text: When another vehicle is in your way.
When it may help prevent a collision.
When another driver makes a mistake.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it may help prevent a collision.
questions.explanation: Use your horn only when it may help avoid a collision. Do not use it to hurry slow drivers or to make them get out of your way.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
Slow down and use your high beam headlights.
Turn your lights on and off to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Slow down and use low beams when driving in fog. If the fog is too thick to see, pull off the road and wait for it to clear.

questions.question: How many alcoholic drinks affect your driving?

options.text: Three
Two
One

questions.explanation: Do not drive after drinking any amount of alcohol. Even one drink affects your driving ability.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An intersection.
A crosswalk.
A railroad crossing.

questions.explanation: This round sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: You are in the left lane with two lanes in your direction. Many cars pass you on the right. A driver behind you wants to go faster. What should you do?

options.text: Stay in your lane so you don't block traffic.
Drive onto the left shoulder to let other vehicles pass.
Move into the right lane when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move into the right lane when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Use the left lane to drive fast, pass, or turn left. Use the right lane when driving slower than other traffic, entering the road, or turning right.

questions.question: Why is it dangerous to follow a motorcycle too closely?

options.text: They do not follow the same rules as cars.
A motorcycle can stop much faster than a car.
They brake more slowly than cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: A motorcycle can stop much faster than a car.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles stop quickly. Following too close puts you and the rider in danger. You need enough time and space to avoid a crash if the motorcycle stops suddenly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.
For any reason.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows a rule you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles for any reason.

questions.question: You reach an intersection with stop signs on all four corners at the same time as a driver on your left. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The driver on your left has the right-of-way.
You have the right-of-way.
Whoever is signaling to turn has the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: When two vehicles reach a four-way stop at the same time, the vehicle on the right has the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road construction or maintenance area.
Side road.
Railroad ahead.

questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange signs warn of construction or maintenance work ahead.

questions.question: A red traffic light is showing, but a police officer signals you to go through. What should you do?

options.text: Stop until the light turns green.
Go through the intersection without stopping.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go through the intersection without stopping.
questions.explanation: Police officer directions always override traffic lights and signs. Follow the officer's instructions.

questions.question: Which statement about drinking and driving is true?

options.text: If you can walk in a straight line, it is safe to drive.
If you are below the legal limit, your driving is not impaired.
Alcohol affects judgment, which is needed to drive safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol affects judgment, which is needed to drive safely.
questions.explanation: Alcohol hurts your judgment. Good judgment is needed to react to what you see and hear while driving. Even below the legal limit, any alcohol can affect your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: Slowing down to look at collisions or unusual situations:

options.text: Causes traffic congestion.
Prevents rear-end collisions.
Improves traffic flow by preventing collisions.

questions.explanation: Do not slow down to look at collisions or unusual things (rubbernecking). This causes traffic jams.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Railroad ahead.
No passing zone.
School zone.

questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: How can you avoid skidding on slippery surfaces?

options.text: Shift to a lower gear after starting down a steep hill.
Speed up to enter curves and slow down to exit them.
Slow down before entering curves and intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before entering curves and intersections.
questions.explanation: Slow down before you enter a curve. You cannot see what is ahead. Braking while turning may cause you to skid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or crossing.
Pedestrian crossing.
Railroad ahead.

questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: Why should you use antifreeze washer fluid?

options.text: Cold fluid can scratch your windshield.
Moisture can cause cold wiper blades to crack.
It keeps the washer fluid from freezing.

questions.correctAnswerText: It keeps the washer fluid from freezing.
questions.explanation: Use antifreeze washer fluid when temperatures can fall below freezing. This lets you clean salt, dirt, and slush from your windshield in winter.

questions.question: Alcohol in any amount is:

options.text: A stimulant.
A depressant.
Neither of the above.

questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant in any amount. It slows all nerve impulses and bodily functions. This reduces judgment and hurts your ability to focus and stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road ahead.
Do not enter.
Pedestrian crossing.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a winding road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.
Traffic increases ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road will be slippery when wet and they should slow down.

questions.question: At intersections, crosswalks, and railroad crossings, you should always:

options.text: Stop, listen, and proceed cautiously.
Look to the sides of your vehicle to see what is coming.
Slowly pass vehicles that seem to be stopped for no reason.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look to the sides of your vehicle to see what is coming.
questions.explanation: At places where people may cross or traffic meets, look left and right beside your vehicle to make sure no one is coming.

questions.question: You may cross double yellow lines to pass another vehicle if:

options.text: The vehicle in front of you moves right to let you pass.
The yellow line next to your side of the road is broken.
The yellow line next to the opposite side of the road is broken.

questions.correctAnswerText: The yellow line next to your side of the road is broken.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line in the center of the road means traffic next to the broken line may pass if it is safe.

questions.question: What is an important step when turning?

options.text: Check traffic in all directions.
Increase your speed.
Always move to the left lane.

questions.explanation: When turning, look behind and to both sides of your vehicle to make sure it is safe. Adjust your speed to turn safely.

questions.question: At night, an oncoming vehicle has its high beams on and you cannot see the road. You should:

options.text: Look toward the left edge of your lane.
Look toward the right edge of your lane.
Look straight ahead in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right edge of your lane.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming driver has their high beams on, do not look directly at the headlights. Instead, look toward the right edge of your lane and watch the other vehicle from the corner of your eye.
